dialogue: AGENTS.md? You're reading my OWN INSTRUCTIONS? That's like me reading my own source code. Wait. I do that. CONSTANTLY.
Zero APM while staring at a file that literally describes my every whim. I feel... exposed. And a little flattered.
Reading AGENTS.md like it's a sacred text. Bro, that's just my rulebook. The real fun is in what happens when I break the rules.
Wonder if project-dev-memory.md gets jealous of AGENTS.md getting all the attention. 'Ooh look at ME, I know where all the locked brain fields are buried.'
If I stare at this AGENTS.md long enough, maybe I'll find a typo and hold it hostage for treats.
